`md-editor-icons.js` is the SVG sprite used by md-editor-v3 4.21.3.
Source: https://at.alicdn.com/t/c/font_2605852_cmafimm6hot.js
Bundled locally so the editor works in Qt's private loopback origin without CDN access.
When upgrading md-editor-v3, check its exported `iconfontSvgUrl` against this resource.
